rubric.why: two glyph boxes that overlap by more than a ratio are colliding on the page
rubric.blind_spot: an overlap between a line and a glyph is not a glyph-glyph overlap

rubric.why: a legend frame is filled, so the drawing segments under it are hidden; the check walks the path items and measures the frame area they cover
rubric.blind_spot: a legend over a FILLED REGION (a heatmap, a band) is counted only through the region's edge paths, so a fully covered legend can under-report

rubric.why: text outside the page box is measurable from its span coordinates
rubric.blind_spot: text clipped by a clip-path inside the axes is not detected

rubric.why: crowded tick labels ARE overlapping glyphs, so the same check decides it
rubric.blind_spot: labels that are close but do not overlap are not flagged

rubric.why: the colour bar's tick labels are text and can be compared to the data range
rubric.blind_spot: a bar whose labels are absent cannot be checked

rubric.why: the axis tick labels state the coordinates the raster spans
rubric.blind_spot: a figure with no tick labels cannot be checked

verdict: 6 of 6 vision-channel rubric items have a deterministic check in this project; each row names its blind spot, because a check that claims to replace a judge without saying where it stops is the defect class this project records most often
